source.locator: README 'Overall Results' table, row YAHOO, column LOF (AUC 0.86, F 0.62)

entries.notes: Now apples-to-apples: labts scores the same 367 TSB-UAD series and averages per-series AUC. F1 not compared (TSB-UAD uses a mu+3-sigma threshold on normalized scores; detector thresholds here differ).
entries.train_command: python playground/labts.py train --algorithm registered-anomaly_detection-PyODLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo --model-id bench-detection-lof-yahoo-auc --param contamination=0.1 --param n_neighbors=20

source.title: ROCKET: Exceptionally Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification Using Random Convolutional Kernels (Dempster, Petitjean, Webb)
source.locator: official results_ucr.csv, row ItalyPowerDemand, accuracy_mean column

entries.notes: sktime RocketClassifier matches the paper protocol (10,000 kernels + RidgeClassifierCV). Kernels are random, so single-run accuracy varies within the paper's reported std (~0.001).

entries.settings: k=3 (= number of classes); full dataset clustered (train+test fused, N=211); mean over 10 runs of the authors' Matlab implementation

source.title: k-Shape: Efficient and Accurate Clustering of Time Series (Paparrizos & Gravano) — official Matlab repository
source.locator: README 'Results on the 128 univariate datasets', row ArrowHead (RI 0.623006, ARI 0.17425450, NMI 0.2533444)

entries.notes: Paper value is the mean of 10 Matlab runs; labts runs tslearn's KShape once with a fixed seed on the fused set (fit_on=all, matching the paper's no-held-out protocol). Random init makes single-run ARI swing.
entries.train_command: python playground/labts.py train --algorithm registered-clustering-TimeSeriesKShapes --dataset arrow-head-cl --model-id bench-clustering-kshape-arrowhead --param n_clusters=3 --param fit_on=all --param random_state=42 --param max_iter=300 --param n_init=10 --param tol=0.0001

entries.settings: k=2 (= number of classes); full dataset clustered (train+test fused, N=306); mean over 10 runs of the authors' Matlab implementation

source.title: k-Shape: Efficient and Accurate Clustering of Time Series (Paparrizos & Gravano) — official Matlab repository
source.locator: README 'Results on the 128 univariate datasets', row GunPoint (RI 0.497487, ARI -0.005050, NMI 0.0)

entries.notes: GunPoint clustering is at chance level even for the authors (RI 0.4975, NMI 0.0) — reproducing this row validates near-chance behavior, not a bug.
entries.train_command: python playground/labts.py train --algorithm registered-clustering-TimeSeriesKShapes --dataset gunpoint-cl --model-id bench-clustering-kshape-gunpoint --param n_clusters=2 --param fit_on=all --param random_state=42 --param max_iter=300 --param n_init=10 --param tol=0.0001
